scientific_integrity: All rank claims have a mathematical proof and a separate finite-field tester; neither proves historical novelty. Free normal form and Jacobi basis rules are credited to prior sources; independent validation is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the free rank-two Jacobi–Jordan algebra over fields of characteristic distinct from 2 and 3. The rank-stratum geometry refers to underlying reduced sets, not the full determinantal schemes. The published normal form is prior work; publication-priority comparisons remain incomplete and human assessment has not occurred.
title: Multiplication-rank strata of the free two-generator Jacobi–Jordan algebra
